macros.name: mmzAbort
macros.doc: This command aborts the ongoing memoization.

macros.name: mmznext
macros.doc: This command accepts the same ⟨options⟩ as \mmzset, but interprets them as next-options — options which will be applied to the next, and only the next, automemoized command or environment.

macros.name: mmzset
macros.doc: Memoize can be configured using command \mmzset{⟨keylist⟩} (and friends). The ⟨keylist⟩ argument is a comma-separated list of configuration settings, each setting having the form ⟨key⟩=⟨value⟩, or sometimes just ⟨key⟩.

macros.name: mmzUnmemoizable
macros.doc: This command aborts the ongoing memoization, and marks the submitted code as unmemoizable.

macros.name: nommzkeys
macros.doc: In package memoize, this command is a no-op; in packages nomemoize and memoizable, it defines key /mmz/⟨key⟩ as a no-op.
